page_title: VER 0-0 PIS | Verona v Pisa 06/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's the end of the match.
90+4' Suat Serdar (Verona) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
90+1' Marius Marin (Pisa) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Daniele Doveri shows the yellow card to Marius Marin (Pisa) for a heavy challenge.
87' Michel Aebischer (Pisa) tries his luck with a shot, but his effort goes wide of the target.

87' Henrik Meister (Pisa) receives a precise pass inside the box and drills a promising first-time blast towards the middle of the goal. His effort is blocked by Lorenzo Montipo who dives to keep the ball out. What a save!
85' Paolo Sammarco decides to make a substitution. Sandi Lovric will be replaced by Abdou Harroui (Verona).
82' Gift Orban goes off the pitch and Daniel Mosquera (Verona) comes on.
81' Idrissa Toure (Pisa) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.

81' Antonio Caracciolo (Pisa) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Lorenzo Montipo shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.

81' Stefano Moreo (Pisa) is very close to scoring! He climbs high to meet a well-taken corner kick and sends it towards the right post. The goalkeeper shows good reflexes as he launches himself into the air and stops the header.
80' Pisa have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
80' Pisa seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
75' Oscar Hiljemark has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Marius Marin (Pisa) replacing Felipe Loyola.
70' We are about to witness a subsitution. Pol Lirola (Verona) for Cheikh Niasse.
69' Stefano Moreo (Pisa) outjumps his marker and heads the resulting corner high over the bar.
69' The ball goes out of play. Pisa are awarded a corner kick.
69' Oscar Hiljemark has decided to substitute Filip Stojilkovic and he is replaced by Henrik Meister (Pisa).
69' Substitution. Rosen Bozhinov is replaced by Arturo Calabresi (Pisa).
68' Samuele Angori (Pisa) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
68' Verona failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
66' Pisa enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
64' Verona take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
56' Filip Stojilkovic (Pisa) has to stretch for the ball in the box and sends it well wide of the left post.
55' Stefano Moreo (Pisa) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
53' Rosen Bozhinov (Pisa) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Daniele Doveri blows his whistle for a foul.
53' The Verona players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
50' Filip Stojilkovic (Pisa) is caught offside!
46' Oscar Hiljemark makes a switch. Mehdi Pascal Marcel Leris (Pisa) is coming on in place of Rafiu Durosinmi at the start of the second period.
46' Half-time substitution. Martin Frese is replaced by Domagoj Bradaric (Verona).
46' Antoine Bernede (Verona) is not able to continue due to his injury and will be replaced by Suat Serdar.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
45' Antoine Bernede (Verona) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
43' Antoine Bernede (Verona) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
37' Gift Orban (Verona) glances on a header from the corner sent into the near post, but his close-range effort is blocked by a defender.
36' Verona will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
33' Gift Orban (Verona) produces a decent strike goalwards from the resulting set piece. His effort rattles the right post and the ball stays out of the net. The goalkeeper was quite lucky!
32' Stefano Moreo (Pisa) sees a yellow card from Daniele Doveri after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
30' The ball falls kindly for Sandi Lovric (Verona) inside the box, but it's a poor effort and flies well wide of the right post.
30' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Verona.
29' Verona quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
26' A cross from a corner kick by Verona is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
25' The referee blows his whistle, Verona are awarded a corner kick.
21' Verona fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
17' Samuele Angori (Pisa) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear.
17' Gift Orban (Verona) commits a rough challenge and Daniele Doveri blows his whistle for an infringement.
10' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Gift Orban (Verona) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well wide of the right post.
8' A dangerous looking corner kick from Michel Aebischer (Pisa) is cleared to safety by the defence.
7' Stefano Moreo (Pisa) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked. The ball is out of play and Pisa manage to earn a corner.
7' The ball goes out of play. Pisa are awarded a corner kick.
7' Rafiu Durosinmi (Pisa) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
4' A pass by Martin Frese (Verona) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Pisa will kick the game off.
The referee of today's match will be Daniele Doveri.
